faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about BodyMaxx AI

items.question: How does the AI body scan work?
items.answer: Our AI uses your phone's camera to create a 3D model of your body. It analyzes key measurements and body composition metrics using advanced computer vision algorithms, all processed locally on your device for privacy.

items.question: Is my data secure and private?
items.answer: Absolutely. Your body scans are processed on-device and never uploaded to external servers. All personal data is encrypted and you have full control over what you share.

items.question: What devices are supported?
items.answer: BodyMaxx AI will be available on iOS (iPhone 8 and newer) and Android (devices with ARCore support). We're optimizing for the best experience across all supported devices.

items.question: How accurate is the body composition analysis?
items.answer: Our AI achieves accuracy comparable to professional DEXA scans for most body composition metrics. The more you use the app, the more accurate your personalized baseline becomes.

items.question: Will there be a free version?
items.answer: Yes! We'll offer a free tier with basic scanning and tracking features. Premium features like advanced analytics, unlimited history, and personalized programs will be available via subscription.

items.question: When will the app launch?
items.answer: We're currently in closed beta testing. Join the waitlist to be among the first to get access when we launch publicly. Early waitlist members will receive exclusive benefits.
